In [[algebraic topology]], '''Steenrod homology''' is a [[homology theory]] for [[compact metric space]]s introduced by {{harvs|txt|last=Steenrod|first=Norman|authorlink=Norman Steenrod|year1=1940|year2=1941}}, based on regular cycles.
It is similar to the homology theory introduced rather sketchily by [[Andrey Kolmogorov]] in 1936.{{Attribution needed|date=August 2018}}
